summary.answer: Inventory helpers write isOpen, conditionally send multi-pickup close response, forward item-focus notification then native refresh, and close PC splitter by focus/state/cursor/detail/list-delay/input-override cleanup in source order. LastStand is progress>0 OR beingRevived==1; online Spectre helper returns false offline else playlist isSpectreRising==true. Quest update consumes notify type/id/objectives, creates objective state models, sets completed0/1 from processed values and preserves special2; no payload validation. Quick-access registration maps widgets and disable-cycle flag. Open sets open/sound/dpad before attempting prior selection then sorted widgets; retain recovered f259_local4 out-of-scope else reference, no repaired cycling formula. Close sets false/sound/refresh, loses selected focus and gives menu focus. Cycle health/equipment notify only on nonrepeat but always reset close timer. Weapon next always execs, prev only PC, slot uses native. Multi-pickup PC visibility hides only its previously activated inventory under exact scoreboard/tab guards, then clears flag. UIHidden first rejects non-WZ, honors forced hide setting, then exact show/team-size/hide profile enums. Model/backend/native/settings, lifetime and real HMH invocation stay conditional.
